blocks.text: Bairooni circuit ke taaron mein electron flow ki simt dono half-cells ki E standard qeematon ke muqable se nikalti hai. Figure 10.9 mein voltages Ag+(aq) + e- se Ag(s), +0.80 V, aur Zn2+(aq) + 2e- se Zn(s), -0.76 V hain. Nisbati qeematein dikhati hain ke Zn2+ ions Ag+ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain, to zinc metal Ag+/Ag half-cell ko electrons deta hai aur Ag+ ions Zn2+/Zn half-cell se electrons lete hain. Electrons bairooni circuit ke taaron mein chalte hain, electrolyte solution mein nahi: flow Zn2+/Zn half-cell se Ag+/Ag half-cell ki taraf hai, manfi pole se musbat pole ki taraf, kyunke zyada musbat pole manfi electrons ko kheenchta hai.

blocks.alt: Standard electrode potential ki tarteeb mein chhe half-reactions: Cl2/Cl- +1.36, Ag+/Ag +0.80, Cu2+/Cu +0.34, H+/H2 0.00, Zn2+/Zn -0.76 aur Mg2+/Mg -2.38 V. Baen taraf oopar ka teer baen ke ajza ki oxidising taqat barhti dikhata hai, Cl2 sab se taqatwar oxidising agent; daen taraf neeche ka teer daen ke ajza ki reducing taqat barhti dikhata hai, Mg sab se taqatwar reducing agent.
blocks.caption: Kuch oxidizing aur reducing agents ke standard electrode potentials (Figure 10.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Fe2+/Fe (-0.44 V) aur Cu2+/Cu (+0.34 V) se bane cell mein electrons kis taraf behte hain aur ions kis taraf chalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Electrons taar se iron electrode (zyada manfi, manfi pole, jahan Fe oxidise hota hai) se copper electrode (musbat pole, jahan Cu2+ reduce hota hai) ki taraf behte hain. Salt bridge mein cations copper half-cell ki taraf aur anions iron half-cell ki taraf sarakte hain taake dono solutions neutral rahein; electrons kabhi solutions se nahi guzarte.

items: Electrons bairooni taaron mein zyada manfi E standard wale half-cell (manfi pole, Zn) se zyada musbat (musbat pole, Ag) ki taraf behte hain; kabhi electrolyte se nahi.
